display.purpose: Episode title on the stage; condensed uppercase Archivo, max 18ch.

page-title.purpose: PageHeader on About, Contact, and other standalone pages.

rail-title.purpose: Show name in the desktop rail.

headline.purpose: Section titles: Show notes, Listen on, Meet the hosts.

row-title.purpose: Episode titles in the list; current episode takes voice-0.

lede.purpose: Paragraph under a page title, max 62ch.

label.purpose: Rail group labels, Presented by, Host/Guest tags.

script-live-voice-0.purpose: The line being heard, first speaker.

script-live-voice-1.purpose: The line being heard, second speaker, right-aligned.

script-live-caption.purpose: The line being heard with no attributed speaker.

script-rest.purpose: Lines away from the live one; size set by data-d.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Stage frame and show art. Night: 0 1px 2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.3), 0 12px 32px -12px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.6).

shadows.name: shadow-float
shadows.purpose: Artwork in the frame, stage play disc, bottom sheets, the floating picture. Night: 0 2px 8px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.35), 0 28px 70px -18px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.75).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: State changes, reveals, sheets, page transitions, unfold.

motion.name: ease-spring
motion.purpose: Press feedback, switch thumb, scrubber thumb, play glyph, mini-player scale.

motion.name: fill
motion.purpose: Solid controls fade into the gradient (--fill-a/--fill-b); icon gradient stops.

motion.name: script-flip
motion.purpose: Live script lines FLIP to their new boxes; jumps over 3 lines crossfade.

motion.name: page-curtain
motion.purpose: View-transition curtain between pages; shell parts crossfade 180ms; dock never animates.

motion.name: morph
motion.purpose: List row art and title morph into the stage.

motion.name: unfold
motion.purpose: Foldable pages swing from rotateY(62deg) once on unfold.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion, animation durations collapse to 1ms (so their events still fire); transition durations and delays are 0s.

breakpoints.name: foldable
breakpoints.value: (horizontal-viewport-segments: 2), or coarse pointer 700-1180px wide at 6/5-8/5 aspect, max-height 960px

engineState: html: data-world="stage" (fixed), data-medium (watch|listen), data-host (stage|dock), data-playing (true|false), data-has-video, data-episode, data-mini, data-picture, data-phone, data-island, data-unfolding
controls: data-buffering on .play-toggle, data-flash (keyboard acts as hover)
script lines: data-v (voice), data-d (distance, -5 spoken to 2 upcoming), data-long, data-index
Up next tiles: data-arriving (for 1.5s as a tile lands)

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Typeset Conversation"**

A podcast is people talking, so Starpod typesets the conversation. The episode stage puts the video (or the show's artwork) beside a live script in which each voice has its own face, the line being heard swells to display size, and spoken lines shrink and soften back into the page. Everything else (the list of episodes, the shell, the pages) speaks in the same condensed, uppercase display voice and a calm grotesque for UI.

One engine runs the whole visit. A single persistent `<video>` element plays the episode's HLS video or MP3, moves physically between the episode stage and the dock, and writes playback state onto `<html data-*>` so CSS can react without islands (progress is the media clock's `--live-progress`, on whatever opts into it). Light and dark are both first-class: day uses Iris, night uses Aqua. The styles are still scoped under `<html data-world="stage">`, which is hardcoded; there is one world.

The system is generic by construction. Show artwork and cast photos supply the only imagery colour, shown in full colour, and every surface has to look deliberate for any show's art.
keyCharacteristics: One OKLCH palette, one shell, one Stage world.
Light is computed, not painted: the scrubber, the dock edge, and the stage light all take their position or colour from real playback.
Iris by day, Aqua by night. The accent marks interaction, current state, and playback, nothing else.
Three hover behaviours, never mixed: a gradient ring on outlined controls, a gradient fill on solid ones, a gradient icon on bare icons.
Condensed uppercase Archivo for every title; Familjen Grotesk for everything you read or operate.
Fixed navigation keeps play, follow, and navigation on screen at every size.

rules.name: The Two Lamps Rule
rules.body: Iris is the only accent by day and Aqua the only accent by night. Accent fills are limited to interaction, the current item, and playback, and never decorate resting content.

rules.name: The Computed Light Rule
rules.body: Every moving gradient or glow takes its position from the media clock's `--live-progress`, from sampled video, or from a hover/focus state. A gradient that no state drives does not belong in the system.

rules.name: The OKLCH Only Rule
rules.body: Every colour is authored in OKLCH, including shadows, masks, and backdrops. Hex and rgb are never used.

rules.name: The One Palette Rule
rules.body: Starpod's styles use only the token colours above, which Tailwind's theme exposes as utilities. Tailwind's default palette is still loaded, but nothing uses it; the typography plugin's prose takes the tokens too. There are no parallel light/dark colour pairs; a single token class follows both schemes.

rules.name: The One Face Per Voice Rule
rules.body: In the script and the cast, voice 0 is condensed Archivo in the voice-0 colour, voice 1 is Young Serif in the voice-1 colour and right-aligned, and further voices or unattributed captions are Familjen in ink. A voice face always identifies a speaker.

rules.name: The Volume Rule
rules.body: Size, width, and opacity carry distance from the live line. They are set by the engine's `data-d` attribute and never by hand.

rules.name: The Upright Time Rule
rules.body: Every timestamp is upright, tabular, and in `HH:MM:SS` on seek chips.

rules.name: The Never-Hidden CTA Rule
rules.body: Play, follow, and navigation are fixed chrome at every size: the rail on desktop, the top bar plus tab bar plus dock below that. Page content pads for every fixed layer it could sit under.

rules.name: The Stage Light Rule
rules.body: The glow behind the stage frame is sampled from the playing video into a 32×18 canvas (artwork glow when nothing plays). It is one of two computed ambient colours (the other is the player's now-playing tone) and it is always computed.

rules.name: The Two Shadows Rule
rules.body: Soft and Float are the shared elevation shadows; only objects in flight or held (the island, a dragged tile, the close-up) cast their own. A hover is shown by the ring, the gradient fill, or a Raised fill, never by a deeper shadow or a lift.

rules.name: The Pill Controls Rule
rules.body: If it can be pressed, it is round. Chrome and the media frame are near-square (3–4px); cards, trays, tiles and rows follow the concentric `--r-*` scale (28, 24, 20, 16, 12px); corner radius on controls is full.

rules.name: The Shape-Keeping Focus Rule
rules.body: Focus never changes an element's shape. The global ring is a 2px accent outline at 3px offset that follows the element's own radius; fields replace it with an accent border and a 4px Accent Wash ring.

rules.name: The Three Hovers Rule
rules.body: Outlined controls draw the ring; solid controls fill with the gradient; bare icons turn the icon to the gradient. A control gets exactly one, and every one transitions.

dos: **Do** read state from the engine: style `[data-current]`, `[data-playing]`, `[data-watching]`, `[data-buffering]`, `html[data-medium]`, `html[data-host]`, and the media clock's `--live-progress` instead of adding new JS-driven classes.
**Do** style new work with Tailwind utilities on the token colours; keep custom CSS for what Tailwind cannot express (`@property` animations, the ring, view transitions, voice typography).
**Do** choose the hover by the control's shape: ring for outlined, gradient fill for solid, gradient icon for bare icons, always with a transition.

**Do** use the easings: expo-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) for state and reveal, the `--ease-halo` curve for the ring, and the overshooting `linear()` spring for press, thumb, and glyph motion. Under `prefers-reduced-motion` animations collapse to 1ms (so their events still fire), and transition durations and delays are 0s.
**Do** open standalone pages with `PageHeader` and align them to the breadcrumbs.
**Do** give fields visible labels and the accent border plus Accent Wash ring on focus.
donts: **Don't** author colour in hex, rgb, or hsl anywhere, including docs, shadows, and masks.
**Don't** reintroduce parallel light/dark Tailwind colours (`bg-light-*`, `dark:bg-dark-*`). Use the single token class.
**Don't** let an accent fill decorate resting content.
**Don't** reshape an element on focus or put a ring on a control that already fills or has no outline.
**Don't** add a new elevation shadow for resting surfaces, or a hover lift.
**Don't** desaturate or duotone show art or cast photos; show imagery in full colour.
**Don't** use a voice face (Archivo condensed as a speaker, Young Serif) for anything other than a speaker or their name; Archivo as a title face is fine.
**Don't** hide play, follow, or navigation behind scroll.
**Don't** add show-specific copy, colour, or imagery to the package. Show artwork and the site's own data are the only imagery and content sources.
